description: The shared base of every two-state control (switch, checkbox): it reads `isSelected` as the `checked` facet, blocks activation while the control is disabled or read-only, and toggles `isSelected` on `activate`. A component that differs overrides the `checked` facet (checkbox adds indeterminate) or the `activate` transition (checkbox also clears `isIndeterminate`). The extending contract lists `isSelected`, `isDisabled` and `isReadOnly` in its `state`.
